description:
About the Role

Wonderful is seeking a dynamic, business-oriented (Spanish Speaking) In-House Commercial Lawyer to join our growing team. In this role, you will act as a strategic legal partner to the business, guiding commercial transactions and managing legal risk while actively enabling company growth. We are looking for a legal commercial lawyer who is fully bilingual in English and Spanish, with the specific ability to draft, negotiate, and finalize complex agreements with our Spanish-speaking customer base.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Drafting & Negotiation: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of commercial agreements—including master service agreements, vendor contracts, NDAs, and partnership agreements—in both Spanish and English.

  • Customer-Facing Legal Support: Lead commercial negotiations directly with Spanish-speaking clients, ensuring smooth deal closures while protecting the company's legal and business interests.

  • Business-Oriented Counsel: Provide practical, solutions-driven legal advice to internal stakeholders, balancing legal risk with commercial realities and business objectives.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with sales, operations, and leadership teams to streamline contracting processes and support revenue-generating initiatives.

 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Legal Credentials: Licensed attorney.

  • Language Fluency: Professional bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish. You must possess the advanced vocabulary and technical skill required to draft, redline, and negotiate binding legal documents in Spanish.

  • Commercial Background: Proven experience specializing in commercial transactions, ideally with an in-house legal department or a corporate practice at a top-tier law firm.

  • Geographic Location: United States or a Latin American (LATAM) country.

Interview process

  • Silver Screening Interview

  • Client Screening Interview

  • Client Takehome + Defense

  • Client Behavioral Interview
